title: Newly arrived Filipino J-1 teachers begin new chapter in Tucson, Arizona
summary: For Filipino teacher Nita Moreno, pursuing her dream of teaching in the United States meant leaving behind someone she loves most: her seven-year-old daughter in the Philippines.
